caption: The Tasks plugin completes Send the invoice to Ana, and a link to today appears before the done date.
eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 12 && document.querySelector('.modal-container'); i++) { document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const T = 'obsidian-tasks-plugin'; if (!app.plugins.plugins[T]?.apiV1) { await app.plugins.enablePluginAndSave(T); for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !app.plugins.plugins[T]?.apiV1; i++) await sleep(100); await sleep(800); } const ed = () => app.workspace.activeEditor.editor; const n = ed().getValue().split('\n').findIndex((l) => l.includes('Send the invoice')); ed().setCursor({ line: n, ch: 0 }); app.commands.executeCommandById('obsidian-tasks-plugin:toggle-done'); await sleep(4500); ed().setCursor({ line: 0, ch: 0 }); await sleep(600); return 'ok'; })()
